items.text: You must learn to proceed with uncertainty.
I am where I am supposed to be and good things are always meant for me.
I am thankful for the tears that helped my garden bloom.
I choose to believe that amazing things are meant for me.
You owe it to yourself to become everything you've ever dreamed of becoming.
You are made of all the beautiful things.
Trust it will all work out.
I am so glad you are here.
Thank you for growing with me.
